# PLY2646 — construct outside the classic Visual Basic profile

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Message | `'<construct>' is not supported by the classic Visual Basic profile` |
| Severity | error |
| Exit code | 3 (UnsupportedConstruct) |
| Strict promotion | no |
| Rule | `visualbasic.frontend.construct` |
| Area | visualbasic |
| Owning issue | #1090 |
| Status | active |
| Seen in | standard error of polypiler translate --from visualbasic; stops import |

## Cause

The module uses a construct of classic Visual Basic that the `visualbasic` frontend does not import,
named in the message: a type (`Decimal`, `Object`, …), a statement (`GoSub`, `With`, `For Each`, …), a
function (`Format`, `Now`, `DateAdd`, …), the text of a `Date` - which Visual Basic writes in the Short
Date and Long Time formats of the host's regional settings - or a `Variant` whose result would depend
on what the frontend does not model. A `Variant` is imported (see the
[frontend](../../architecture/VISUALBASIC-FRONTEND.md#variant)), and so are the text of a `Single` or
a `Double` and a `String` read as a number, by the locale `--vb-locale` states; refused are a `LongLong`
in a `Variant`, `^`, `\`, `Mod`, a bitwise operator or a condition of a `Variant` that may hold a
`Currency`, a `Variant` that may hold an array and another kind, and `Variant` fields.

## Example

```text
$ polypiler translate Report.bas --from visualbasic --to csharp --output out
Report.bas(4,1): error PLY2646: 'the text of a Date, which Visual Basic writes in the Short Date and Long Time formats of the regional settings' is not supported by the classic Visual Basic profile
```

for

```vb
Public Sub Report()
    Dim d As Date
    d = DateSerial(2000, 1, 2)
    Debug.Print d
End Sub
```

## What to do

Give the value the form its use needs: write the parts of a date (`Year(d) & "-" & Month(d)`), convert
a value where its kind matters (`CLng(v)` before a bitwise operator), keep different kinds in separate
variables, or declare the variable with its type. A construct outside the profile has to be rewritten
in the subset the [frontend](../../architecture/VISUALBASIC-FRONTEND.md) lists.
